change: Check world pose before other unchanged-component comparisons; compare collider shape once during update; pass validated world pose into common collider placement instead of decomposing it again. Joined colliders still use relative transforms; refits compute pose lazily from the entry.

focused.scope: 5000 moving and rotating unparented colliders; 20 warmup and 60 synchronization samples; no solver/rendering; scene propagation outside timer. Checks 5000 candidates and final collider position.
focused.harnessCorrection: Initial draft used direct Transform writes with stateless propagation and did not move colliders. Those measurements were discarded; recorded runs use scene::set_local and verify actual processing/motion.

dense.scope: Native-only cooked workload; no Dart or rendering; 40 warmup and 300 measured ticks.
dense.interpretation: Sync reductions vary across pairs; whole-tick improvement is not consistent. Do not interpret as overall game FPS gain.

validation.regression: Collider retains its handle and correct world rotation/translation with nonuniform scale and a nonzero rotated/scaled offset.
